name: Page outline & link explorer
description: Explore long articles, documentation and research pages in a searchable sidebar. Jump to visible headings, browse unique links with source domains, and filter external references without losing your place. Open Panels → Page outline & links. Refresh rescans visible DOM content, up to 120 headings and 180 unique HTTP(S) links. Links open through the browser in the originating group. No AI or network fetches, no page styling changes, and no polling. Does not inspect cross-origin frames or unloaded content.
